Optional chaining means when the base value is null, cohost destination calendars collected in teamDestinationCalendars are silently dropped, so collective events lose team members' calendars even when those members have them. This is a verifiable mechanism introduced by this diff.

adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff in handleNewBooking.ts around line 1078, the destinationCalendar is set to either [eventType.destinationCalendar] or [organizerUser.destinationCalendar] or null. Later at line 1067, there's code that does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)` for COLLECTIVE scheduling. If destinationCalendar is null (when both eventType and organizerUser lack one), the optional chaining `?.push()` will silently do nothing, causing all collective cohost calendars in teamDestinationCalendars to be discarded. This is a real bug - the code should initialize to an empty array [] instead of null to allow the push to work.
